altDigivolutionRequirements: [Digivolve]  [Takuya Kanbara] w/5 [Hybrid] trait cards under: Cost 5
cardEffects:
[When Digivolving] For each color in this Digimon's digivolution cards, trash any 1 digivolution card from your opponent's Digimon and suspend 1 of their Digimon. Then, this Digimon may attack.
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle, it gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) for the turn and unsuspends.
name: EmperorGreymon

rulings.question: Can I use this card's digivolution requirement to digivolve for a cost of 5 even when my [Takuya Kanbara] has more than 5 [Hybrid] trait cards under it?

rulings.answer: Yes. After this card's [Your Turn] effect activates, then you perform the security check for ＜Piercing＞.  This card's [Your Turn] effect and ＜Piercing＞ trigger simultaneously, but the activated ＜Piercing＞ is processed immediately before the attack ends, therefore ＜Security A. +1＞ is first gained from this card's [Your Turn] effect, then you perform the security check for ＜Piercing＞.
rulings.question: If this card gains ＜Piercing＞ from another card's effect, then this card attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle, do I perform the security check for ＜Piercing＞ after this card's [Your Turn] effect activates?

rulings.answer: Yes, it can attack.  When digivolving into this card, the turn end conditions won't be met until all of the resulting processing has been resolved.  In this case, this card's [When Digivolving] effect, [Your Turn] effect, and any effects triggered by them must first be resolved, and then the turn end conditions will be met.  Then, the end of the turn timing will occur and BT18-088 [Takuya Kanbara & Koji Minamoto]'s [End of Your Turn] effect will trigger.
rulings.question: BT18-088 [Takuya Kanbara & Koji Minamoto] digivolved into this card, and the memory gauge moved to 1 on my opponent's side.  Then, I used this card’s [When Digivolving] effect to attack and used this card's [Your Turn] effect to unsuspend it.  Can I then use the [End of Your Turn] inherited effect on BT18-088 [Takuya Kanbara & Koji Minamoto] in this card's digivolution cards to attack a player?
Can this card's digivolution requirements also be from "Takuya Kanbara" with more than 5 cards with "Hybrid Body" in the trait below, at a digivolution cost of 5?

rulings.answer: Yes, it activates. and then checks with "Penetrate". This card's [Your Turn] effect and "Penetration" are triggered at the same time, but the activated "Penetration" is processed just before the [End of Attack], so the "Penetration" is checked after the "S Attack +1" is obtained by this card's [Your Turn] effect.
rulings.question: When an opponent's Digimon is deleted in a battle in which this card, which has gained "Penetrate" by the effect of another card, attacks, does this card's [Your Turn] effect activate and then check with "Penetrate"?

rulings.answer: Yes, you can attack. Until you digivolve to this card and resolve all the processes caused by it, you still do not meet the end-of-turn requirements. In this situation, all [When Digivolving] and [End of Your Turn] effects of this card and the effects caused by them are resolved, and the End of Turn condition is satisfied. After that, it becomes End of Turn, and the [End of Your Turn] effect of "BT18-088 Takuya Kanbara & Koji Minamoto" is triggered.
rulings.question: The situation is that you evolved from "BT18-088 Takuya Kanbara & Koji Minamoto" to this card, and its memory is more than 1 on the opponent's side. At this time, I attacked with this card's [When Digivolving] effect and became active with this card's [Your Turn] effect. After that, can I attack a player with the [When Digivolving] effect of [End of Your Turn] of this card's [BT18-088 Takuya Kanbara & Koji Minamoto], which is the digivolving card?

rulings.answer: Yes, for each color of the digivolution source of this card, choose and trash one of your opponent's Digimon digivolution sources and rest one of your opponent's Digimon.
rulings.question: Does this card's [When Digivolving] effect, if this card has three colors of digivolved cards, choose and trash three of the opponent's digivolved Digimon and choose and rest three of the opponent's Digimon?
